description: Exact fraction maths with big integers (never rounded) and worked steps. calculate: an expression with fractions, mixed numbers ("1 1/2"), decimals and repeating decimals ("0.(3)"), + − × ÷ ^ and brackets (a/b binds tighter than ÷). decimal_to_fraction: "0.75", "0.1(6)" (brackets mark the repeating part), with close small-denominator approximations. fraction_to_decimal: exact decimal with the repeating block, and percent. compare: put two or more fractions in order. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/fraction-calc/
name: calc_fraction
title: Fraction calculator
